prompts.prompt: Use case: ui-mockup. Create ONE high fidelity desktop industrial HMI content-area design, landscape 16:10, crisp straight-on flat screenshot, Simplified Chinese, very legible text. This is a WPF .NET Framework motion control machine application for factory technicians, not a website. Draw ONLY the central content workspace; do not draw an app title bar, global navigation, global start/pause/stop/reset buttons, or external browser. Those existing elements are preserved outside this image. No large page heading (the existing Host provides it). Compact familiar table-based Windows controls, white cards on #F3F6FA background, thin #D8E2EE borders, modest 6px radius, primary blue #2375D1, dark blue-gray #26384D text, 13-16px readable body, generous practical spacing, fine table grid lines and clear selected row. No gradients, no dark dashboard, no decorative illustrations, no glass, no web marketing, no microscopic text. Clear status text as well as status colors. Content should fill image with about 18px external margins. Never imply a machine action occurs by selecting a row. Exact engineering example only; all displayed values are mock data. Page: new operator equipment overview workspace. Top single horizontal status card with text "设备已暂停" and "下一步：确认现场状态后，按复位，再按启动", a small neutral badge "示例数据". Below three equal white workstation cards side by side: "上料工位" blue badge "等待", "当前步骤 20", "等待产品到位", small condition row "产品到位 DI：未到位", link-style button "查看任务"; "搬运工位" green badge "运行", "当前步骤 40", "XY 一起移动到放料位", two rows "搬运X  85.2 / 120.0 mm" and "搬运Y  56.8 / 80.0 mm", link "查看任务"; "检测工位" amber badge "等待", "当前步骤 30", "等待拍照区域", row "当前占用：搬运工位", link "查看原因". Below two modest metric cards "本次完成 128" and "当前周期 12.4 s", no OEE charts. Bottom full-width bordered strip "当前提醒" with amber icon and text "检测工位正在等待拍照区域，搬运退出后继续", right secondary button "查看详情". Bottom small note "点击状态只查看信息，设备启停使用顶部固定按钮". Simple, quiet, operator-friendly.
